about: KAN-218: shared .fetproject compatibility vectors for FlappedEar Overlays and FlappedEar Telemetry. Each accepted case is opened from <root>/day/ next to its recordings and saved unchanged to savePath; the result must equal expected as JSON values once the temporary root in every absolutePath is replaced by /vectors and the generated documentState.saveId (and documentState.id, when the input had none) by <generated-uuid>; both must be UUIDs. Rejected cases must fail validation. Regenerate expected files only for a reviewed format change (docs/event-project-format.md).
